verdict.rationale: Attio's workflows marketing names a first-party 'Routing Agent' that 'routes every lead to the right rep or channel', and shows a new-deal trigger feeding a Custom Agent that will 'score the lead and route to the right AE', all built in its visual Workflows builder. This is Attio's own routing capability, but the evidence is only marketing-level and gives no detail on how assignment is configured. Missing for 10: documented rule-based assignment configuration, explicit round-robin distribution, first-party docs on routing setup, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
